paragraphs.text: Iwamori (EE-wa-MOR-ee) of the Open Fist was a human monk of Kamigawa during the time of the Kami War .

Iwamori was a monk who trained as a student of Ansho and a pupil of Dosan . He was renowned as one of the strongest fighters in Jukai , and perhaps all of Kamigawa. He was known to be eager to prove his fighting skill against any and all challengers.
